subject: Final pricing gate: KiteWorks SOW and signoff
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Russo <elena@kiteworks.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final pricing gate: KiteWorks SOW and signoff

Hi Elena,

Following up on our call last week — attached is the latest SOW (v3) and a one-page pricing breakdown for the pilot + first-year commit. Procurement asked for a signed SOW and a confirmed final price so they can close Q2 budget.

Quick summary:
- Proposed committed ARR: $420,000 (12-month)
- Agreed-on discounts: pilot concession + enablement credit = 18% effective off list for year 1
- Remaining open item: deal desk approval for any additional volume-level concession (they flagged a possible extra 5% if customer commits to 24 months)

Can you confirm by EOD today whether procurement is OK with the numbers in the attached SOW and whether they want us to prepare a 24-month option? If yes, I can loop deal desk and finance for an expedited clearance — we need the approved pricing to lock this into the forecast.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, West
Redwood Inference
Attachments: KiteWorks_SOW_v3.pdf, pricing-breakdown-kw-2027-04.xlsx
From: Elena Russo <elena@kiteworks.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: KiteWorks Procurement <procure@kiteworks.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final pricing gate: KiteWorks SOW and signoff

Thanks Kim — receiving this now. Procurement confirms the numbers look right for 12 months; they asked whether the 24-month option reduces the unit price significantly and whether all enablement credits are one-time or spread across the term.

We should be able to sign the 12-month SOW today if you can get final signoff from deal desk on the listed concessions. If the 24-month option is cleaner, procurement would consider it but needs a clear delta.

—Elena
Elena Russo
Director, IT Procurement
KiteWorks
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: KiteWorks pricing gate — need expedited deal desk/finance clearance

Team — copying internal thread so it’s in your inbox: KiteWorks is ready to sign the 12-month SOW if we get clearance on the 18% effective concession (pilot + enablement) as documented. Procurement is also open to a 24-month option if we can show a clear additional discount delta.

Action items (today):
- Karthik: can deal desk confirm acceptance of the 18% effective discount and whether a one-time 5% additional 24-month concession is permissible for this ARR bucket? If a 24-month structure is acceptable, procurement may move the signature forward but we need the final numbers for the DocuSign.
- Vanessa: finance needs a quick validation that booking this at the proposed list and discounts won’t create a forecast variance issue for Q2 (we want to avoid a manual adjustment later).
- Ben: if you can bless the SOW language and attachments, I’ll route to DocuSign the moment we have pricing signoff.

I’ve attached the SOW and a short pricing spreadsheet with the delta scenarios. This is a high-probability close and should be in this quarter’s commit if we don’t delay. Please reply here with one-line approvals or redlines — procurement is waiting.

Thanks,
Kim
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 14:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: KiteWorks pricing gate — need expedited deal desk/finance clearance

Kim — we can approve the 18% effective concession on the 12-month SOW as-is. For a 24-month option, deal desk will allow an additional 5% off list for the extended term (so ~23% effective). Conditions: customer must commit in writing to the 24-month term and payment cadence stays monthly or prepay — if they request net-60 or custom payment terms, we need a separate signoff.

Vanessa — note the volume-based uplift for 24 months will shift ARR recognition; please advise if finance wants to treat as committed ARR now or as multi-term with different recognition — we prefer final call before DocuSign.

Ben — please queue the SOW for signature once Kim confirms procurement chooses 12- or 24-month path.

Approved by: Karthik Iyer (Deal Desk)
